prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity reference sheet, TWO side-by-side portrait Android app screens for a cute Chinese budget app 叽里咕噜, no device frames.
Primary request: COMPACT, SIMPLIFIED, high information density. The user strongly dislikes giant rounded boxes enclosing a few words and oversized inputs. Use warm white paper, restrained lavender ink, clean Chinese typography, curated tiny colored category icons. Charming but practical, no decorative fluff competing with data. Native Android Compose feasibility.
LEFT: a complete manual entry page fits one viewport. Small back arrow and “记一笔” header. A prominent unboxed “¥18” amount with tiny “支出 / 收入” toggle at right. Below, compact underlined or lightly filled 42dp rows: “细则   午餐”, “备注   和朋友吃饭”. No giant outlined textfield rectangles. Categories a bounded compact 3-column by 2-row selector with beautiful consistent native-style icons and labels: 吃饭 (fork), 饮品 (cup), 交通 (bus), 零食 (cookie), 日用 (bag), 待定 (last). Date in one quiet clock-icon row “9月24日 12:05”. A small checked checkbox “自动分类” with tiny inline resolved category “吃饭”. A slim fixed bottom “确认记账” button, all main content comfortably visible without vertical scrolling. Avoid lots of whitespace between elements, use coherent 12–16dp gaps and legible 13–16sp labels. Tiny cloud mascot can sit in a header corner but not occupy a card.
RIGHT: a statistics page in background, subdued. In front ONE small budget editing paper window about 260dp wide and 230dp tall, modest title “小预算”. Unboxed compact numeric input row “预算   ¥1,000”; three short inline cycle tabs “每月 / 每周 / 每天”; concise “从   1日开始” row. Two small footer actions “取消” and “设好啦” aligned and fixed. No huge outline fields, no large empty margins, no popup occupying most screen. Below the popup visible actual statistics may include small ring/category layout; keep backdrop quiet.
Exact Chinese text. No AI-dashboard cards, no enormous pill controls, no lorem ipsum, no English labels, no watermark. Make the design feel hand-tuned and thoughtfully compact.
implementation: Design reference only. Preserve actual existing statistics and three-tab navigation; shrink amount/category circles further to fit manual entry in one viewport.
